request.title: ubc2021-03 Golden Gate assembly of psicA and RFP construct

content_json.text:
- Transforming RFP Constructs
- Moved 5 transformation plates from 37C room to 4C room (as per instructed by Janella)
- Golden Gate Assembly of psicA and golden gate compatible RFP construct (x2 duplicates)
1. IDT psicA gene fragment preparation
- Added 25 uL to make 10 ng/uL of psicA
- Incubated for ~10 minutes at 60 degrees celsius to ensure the solvent comes in contact with the tiny pellet.
2. Golden Gate Assembly Reaction:
- 0.5 uL of T4 ligase
- 1 uL BsaI
- 2 uL 10X T4 Buffer
- 2 uL 10X BSA Buffer
- 6 uL psicA insert + 0.5 uL of DNA amplicon
- Fix volume to 20 uL using H2O
3. Incubated Golden Gate Assembly reaction at 37 degrees celsius for 1hr
